ThreadList.note: A Chats section with five threads, one selected (bg-selected chip) and relative times in the trailing cell. Real thread titles.

ActivityStates.note: Trailing-cell activity: spinner, waiting clock and error badge each beating the relative time. The spinner is caught mid-rotation, which is the shipped animation, not a broken glyph.

SubtitlesAndExpandControl.note: Subtitle rows go to 40px and carry repo/branch; expandControl holds the coding-workspace disclosure IconButton in both open and closed rotation, with a nested workspace row under the expanded thread.

HoverActionRevealed.note: The opacity-0 hoverAction shown in its revealed state via focus-on-mount; note the trailing time correctly fades out on focus-within, which is the row's documented right-slot precedence.
